The salamander's body is elongated and robust, displaying the characteristic glossy black skin with irregular bright yellow spots and bands. Its head is broad with visible parotoid glands behind the eyes. Short, stout limbs are visible, though digit counts are partially obscured by the angle and substrate. The tail extends behind the body, appearing laterally compressed. A faint green watermark or text artifact is visible in the lower center of the image.
